function: Symbol detection (QPSK) in an uplink ISAC SIMO-OFDM receiver with a learned sliding Transformer; target AOA and delay then come from LS plus MUSIC, not learned. p. 1
system: SIMO-OFDM uplink ISAC, BS with Nr=8 antennas (ULA), UE with Nt=1, M=64 subcarriers, static target; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated. p. 3
method: Sliding Transformer (4 encoder layers, one head, ReZero, no positional encoding) classifying QPSK symbols; supervised, cross-entropy loss, trained from scratch for each SNR. p. 2
data_channel: Custom simulation: random QPSK symbols, Rayleigh-style random attenuation, random delays and steering vectors from a normal distribution; no standard or measured channel. p. 3
test_conditions: Train and test on the same channel realisations, then test with CSI differing up to 10% (random factor in [0.9, 1.1]); one model trained per SNR. p. 4
baselines: Learned: SBRNN (Bi-LSTM sliding detector), also pre-trained with transfer learning for convergence tests. Classical: LS channel-estimation-based symbol detection. p. 4
metrics: Symbol error rate versus SNR; training samples and training time to reach 90% accuracy; processing time; AOA error (degrees) and time-delay error (m) versus SNR. p. 4
complexity: Order O(4nd^2) for the Transformer versus O(2n^2d) for Bi-LSTM; Table I, Transformer vs SBRNN: training 142 vs 351 s, processing 0.023 vs 0.006 s. p. 4
q1_support: p. 3: "Attenuation is randomly generated as a rayleigh fading style"; custom simulator with random delays and steering vectors, no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 4: "followed by a multiplication of a random float number between [0.9, 1.1]"; this is a 10% CSI error on the same simulated channel (Fig. 4 legend: 10% CSI estimation error), with no new scenario, antennas, band or dataset.
q3_support: p. 4: "our STransformer outperforms SBRNN for both perfect and imperfect CSI, while outperforming LS when CSI is imperfect"; LS detection is non-learned, SBRNN is an earlier learned detector, compared on SER in Fig. 4.
q4_support: p. 4: "complexity of O(4 ∗ nd 2 ), while the 2-direction bi-LSTM has a time complexity of O(2 ∗ n 2 d )"; Table I on p. 4 also gives training and processing times.
q5_support: p. 3: "Simulations are done to a set of data symbols randomly generated from a normal distribution"; synthetic data, and no code or data link or public dataset appears anywhere in the letter.
notes: Area 1 because the learned part is symbol detection; sensing (AOA, delay) uses LS plus MUSIC, which is not learned, so area 5 (beams, waveforms, resources) does not apply. Table I values read from the page image (p. 4). The title and DOI on p. 1 match the work.
